annotations.title: 13F holdings, fund holdings: what an institution owns

description: The latest 13F-HR holdings of an institutional investment manager (hedge fund, mutual fund family, bank) from SEC EDGAR: each position's issuer, class, CUSIP, value in USD, shares and portfolio weight, largest first, plus the report period, total value and position count. Give the filer by name (e.g. Berkshire Hathaway) or CIK. Public SEC data, filed quarterly up to 45 days after the quarter. Use to see what a fund owns. Example: filer=Berkshire Hathaway. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

cik.description: The filer's SEC CIK, e.g. 1067983 (instead of filer)

filer.description: Fund manager's name, e.g. Berkshire Hathaway (or give cik)
